The Buffalo Wing Crawl

What's on the Buffalo Wing Crawl?

The Buffalo Wing Crawl is a crawl with 5 stops: Anchor Bar (Buffalo), Gabriel's Gate (Allentown, Buffalo), Duff's Famous Wings (Amherst), Elmo's (Amherst) and Bar-Bill Tavern (East Aurora). Tip: Time it for Labor Day weekend and add the National Buffalo Wing Festival.

The birthplace and the contenders. Split a dozen medium at each stop (nobody needs 60 wings) and decide for yourself.
